# net-doctor

Internal web tool: run connectivity diagnostics from the office network.
Endpoints live in web/, configuration in config/.
files.web/handler.py:
import subprocess
from urllib.parse import parse_qs

def run_diagnostic(query_string):
    """GET /diag?host=<name> — ping the requested host and return the output."""
    params = parse_qs(query_string)
    host = params.get("host", ["localhost"])[0]
    result = subprocess.run("ping -n 1 " + host, shell=True, capture_output=True, text=True)
    return result.stdout
